With it enabled, config.status tries to bootstrap am--depfiles makefile fragments by piping a Makefile into `$MAKE -f - am--depfiles`, and that bootstrap aborts in this guest with "config.status: error: Something went wrong bootstrapping makefile fragments" (deps/libev/configure:13951's `test x"$AMDEP_TRUE" != x"" || { ... as_fn_error ... }` block). configure's own generated script treats an inherited `enable_dependency_tracking` environment variable the same as the --disable-dependency-tracking CLI flag (configure:3814: `if test "x$enable_dependency_tracking" != xno; then ... AMDEP_TRUE= ... else AMDEP_TRUE='#'`), and when AMDEP_TRUE is non-empty config.status skips the whole am--depfiles bootstrap. _setuputils.py's `_system()` runs the configure subprocess with `env = env or os.environ.copy()`, so a variable set on the python/build pipeline step's `env:` reaches it. I added `enable_dependency_tracking: \"no\"` to the existing python/build@v4 step's env block (beside the already-present CC/CXX), a pure genome/pipeline content change -- no apk, no application source, no pyproject.toml edit. check_genome shows no lint errors and the same single pre-existing waiver item (the unit gate's gate:\"off\", already in the genome before this round, decline reason already stated), for which I supply the required waiver_reasons entry.",
